tools.name: check_buyer_fit
tools.description: Check whether an Italian B2B buyer with an existing company, domain, CRM or lead list can use MS-DEC-250 to score, rank and prioritize up to 250 records. Coarse non-personal facts only; it creates no order. Calls update only anonymous aggregate counters in memory; submitted data is not saved.

tools.name: get_synthetic_example
tools.description: Preview the JSON produced when MachineSignal scores, classifies, ranks and prioritizes an Italian B2B lead list. Uses approved synthetic data only and creates no order. Calls update only anonymous aggregate counters in memory; submitted data is not saved.

tools.name: get_purchase_requirements
tools.description: Explain the machine-origin purchase prerequisites without accepting an order, returning checkout data or calling a provider. Calls update only anonymous aggregate counters in memory; submitted data is not saved.
